title: puffpai.json (puffpai-package/1)
description: The package manifest. Source: docs/02_PACKAGE_CONTRACT.md (field reference, provider fields, setup steps), docs/zones/ZONES_TOGETHER.md section 1 (slots), docs/03_WIZARD_AND_TOOLSMITH.md 1.1 (wizard steps). The Core reads this file and never runs it. 'x-plain' holds the plain-words message the Core shows when a rule fails.

schema.x-plain: This bot only knows manifests with "schema": "puffpai-package/1".

id.x-plain: The id must be 2 to 40 characters: lower-case letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter (no '_', so it works in a web address, D55).

kind.x-plain: The kind must be one of: app, tool, skill, page, ui, avatar, look, agent, knowledge, bundle, wizard, provider.

version.x-plain: The version must be semver, like 1.0.0.

homepage.x-plain: The homepage must be a web address (http or https).

origin.x-plain: origin is written by the Core: core, store:verified, store:community, github:<url>, local:<path>, adopted:<url> or made.

consent.x-plain: consent must be one or two plain sentences for the Yes card.

run.x-plain: run holds one block per system: windows, mac, linux or default.

tools.x-plain: abilities.tools maps each tool name to one plain description, the same words as its MCP server's (the PuffPAI store shows them before the app is installed).

as_written.description: WritersBot: this app's words go to the brain on this computer as written and come back as written; nothing from them is filed in the vault. For an app whose text is the owner's own work (a manuscript), not her personal records. Shown on the Yes card.

keep_on_remove.x-plain: data.keep_on_remove is ask, keep or delete.

scope.x-plain: scope is the list of intents the agent handles.

model.x-plain: avatar.model is optional; if given it must be a .glb file inside the package (D48a).

preview.x-plain: avatar.preview must be an SVG or PNG file inside the package (D48a).

look.x-plain: A look block is {mode, line, tokens}, with day_tokens when mode is both and an optional preview (D76).

mode.x-plain: look.mode is night, day or both.

line.x-plain: look.line is one plain sentence, up to 200 characters.

preview.x-plain: look.preview must be an SVG or PNG file inside the package.

reads.x-plain: reads is raw, gated, ciphertext or none.

toolsmith_model.description: A frontier model for Toolsmith (slot zone3.toolsmith-model, D35, D42, 02 'Provider fields', 04 quick start 11). Prices are US dollars per million tokens. key.format holds {key}, which only the Core fills. 'wire' names a request and reply mapping the Core runs (a data-only adapter, PROPOSED); without it the provider needs a process adapter.

wire.x-plain: wire is one of the Core's mappings: anthropic-messages, openai-responses or gemini-generate-content.

format.x-plain: key.format must hold {key}, where the Core puts the key.

then.x-plain: A zone3.toolsmith-model provider needs a toolsmith_model block (D35).
An app needs a run block and at least one ui.pages entry or ui.open.
A tool needs an MCP server: abilities.mcp.
A tool with an http MCP server needs a run block to start it.
A page needs ui.pages or ui.widgets, and its run blocks (if any) must be static.
A ui package needs a run block (its own process, or static files).
An avatar needs an avatar block with at least a preview (SVG or PNG); a .glb model is optional (D48a).
A look needs a look block and runs nothing: no run, abilities or ui blocks (D76).
A look whose mode is both needs day_tokens too (tokens are its night).
An agent needs a run block, a scope (its intents) and an MCP server (abilities.mcp).
A knowledge package needs sources (URLs with hashes) or files.
A bundle needs an includes block.
A wizard needs a steps list.
A provider needs provides: [{"slot": "zone<N>.<slot>", "contract": 1}].
A provider that runs a process must declare reads: raw, gated, ciphertext or none.
provides, reads, detector, devices and toolsmith_model are for kind provider only.
A package that runs a process needs a health check, or its Registry row can never say running.
A package with ui.open needs a health check (usually health.file, the program path).
A vault provider (store, unlock, backup) must read ciphertext or none, never plain data.
A model runtime, speech or vision provider sees real values, so it must declare reads: raw.
A process detector sees raw text, so it must declare reads: raw.
A net monitor or policy feed reports or blocks only; it may not list any abilities.changes.
A zone1.detector provider needs a detector block (form and emits).
A zone3.network-device provider needs a devices list.

propertyNames.x-plain: Each look token is a CSS variable name, like --bg: two dashes, then up to 40 letters, digits or '-'.

look_tokens.x-plain: Look tokens are CSS variables, like {"--bg": "#ffffff"}: 1 to 80 names starting with --.

relpath.x-plain: This must be a path inside the package (no drive letter, no leading slash, no '..').

placeheld.x-plain: Only the Core's placeholders are allowed: {port}, {python}, {node}, {data}, {pkg}.

argv.x-plain: This must be one command as a list of arguments, like ["{python}", "-m", "app"].

setup_item.description: One setup step (D51): a command line, an argument list, or one of two Core file steps inside the package folder: {"copy": [from, to]} or {"venv": true}. No shell runs any of them.
setup_item.x-plain: A setup step is a command, an argument list, {"copy": [from, to]} inside the package, or {"venv": true}.

run_env.description: Environment for a command run block (D51). Values may use the Core's placeholders. The Core's own names (PUFFPAI_*, the proxy variables) are never a package's.
run_env.x-plain: env holds plain names (not PUFFPAI_*, proxy variables or system settings like PATH, COMSPEC, PYTHONPATH or NODE_OPTIONS) with text values; only the Core's placeholders are allowed.

tool_name.x-plain: A tool name is letters, digits, '_' or '-', without the '<id>.' prefix.

label_id.x-plain: A label id is dotted, like person.phone or custom.clients.

host.x-plain: A host is a plain name like api.example.com (no wildcards, no scheme, no path).

slot.x-plain: Unknown slot. Slot names are listed in docs/zones/ZONES_TOGETHER.md section 1 (plus zone3.toolsmith-model, D35).

type.x-plain: run type is command, docker_compose or static.

cwd.description: The folder inside the package where start and every argument-list setup step run (D51).

then.x-plain: A command run block needs start (one command as an argument list), or only setup when all it has is an MCP server over stdio (D124); setup is a list of steps; env and cwd are optional (D51).
A docker_compose run block needs file (the compose file inside the package).
A static run block needs dir (the folder of files the Core serves).

health.x-plain: health is one of: {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/...", "expect": 200}, {"command": [...], "expect_exit": 0} or {"file": "<program path>"}, plus every_s.

then.x-plain: An http MCP server needs url, on 127.0.0.1.
A stdio MCP server needs command.

page.x-plain: A page needs exactly one of path (served by the package), file (a static file) or url (an adopted app's own address).

widget.x-plain: A widget needs exactly one of path or file.

name.x-plain: A key name is upper case with '_', like NASA_API_KEY.

step_fields.description: The one step shape (02 'Setup steps', 01 'Checklist'). package and blocks are filled in by the Core.

then.x-plain: A run_command step needs text (the command to copy).
An enter_secret step needs key (the vault name it fills).
An open_url step needs the address in text or get_it.

manifest_step.x-plain: A setup step uses only: id, title, why, kind, shell, text, admin, get_it, key, check (package and blocks are filled in by the Core).

then.x-plain: A secret field must name its home (vault:<name> or package:<id>/<KEY>), D36(a).
